hook.title: The complete **DevOps** course
hook.say: Want to learn DevOps from zero? Starting today, we are covering a complete DevOps course, right here, step by step.

scenes.title: Foundations first
scenes.text: Linux · Networking · Git · Bash and Python scripting
scenes.say: We start with the foundations: Linux, networking, Git, and scripting with Bash and Python.

scenes.title: Build and ship
scenes.say: Then we build and ship software with Docker, C I C D pipelines, and Kubernetes.

scenes.title: Run it in the cloud
scenes.text: Terraform · Ansible · AWS and Azure · Monitoring · DevSecOps
scenes.say: Next comes infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible, the AWS and Azure clouds, monitoring, and security. And we finish with real projects.

scenes.title: DevOps is just the start
scenes.text: Complete courses on **AI**, Machine Learning, Coding and Cloud Computing are coming next.
scenes.say: And DevOps is just the beginning. We will share complete courses on AI, machine learning, coding and cloud computing too.

outro.title: Learn with us
outro.say: Follow, so you don't miss a single lesson. And save this roadmap.

caption:
New series: a complete DevOps course, step by step, right here.

The roadmap:
1. Linux and the command line
2. Networking for DevOps
3. Git and GitHub
4. Bash and Python scripting
5. Docker and containers
6. CI/CD pipelines
7. Kubernetes
8. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform and Ansible
9. Cloud: AWS and Azure
10. Monitoring and logging
11. DevSecOps basics
12. Real projects for your CV

After DevOps, we will share complete courses on AI, Machine Learning, Coding and Cloud Computing.

Which module are you most excited about?
